signature.name: VTask.comapDomain
signature.type: {R : Type u_3} -> {M : Type u_6} -> {N : Type u_7} -> [Semiring R] -> (f : M → N) -> (hf : Function.Injective f) -> (x : MonoidAlgebra R N) -> MonoidAlgebra R M

conventions.statement: For every m : M, the coefficient of m in VTask.comapDomain f hf x equals the coefficient of f m in x.
conventions.note: This is the defining semantic content of the pullback operation.

conventions.statement: For every n : N not in the image of f, any contribution to x at index n is entirely absent from the result.
conventions.note: Coefficients at indices outside the range of f are silently discarded.

facts.statement: ∀ {R : Type*} {M : Type*} {N : Type*} [Semiring R] (f : M → N) (hf : Function.Injective f), VTask.comapDomain f hf (0 : MonoidAlgebra R N) = 0

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; certified by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ {R : Type*} {M : Type*} {N : Type*} [Semiring R] (f : M → N) (hf : Function.Injective f) (x y : MonoidAlgebra R N), VTask.comapDomain f hf (x + y) = VTask.comapDomain f hf x + VTask.comapDomain f hf y

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; certified by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ {R : Type*} {M : Type*} {N : Type*} [Semiring R] (f : M → N) (hf : Function.Injective f) (r : R) (x : MonoidAlgebra R N), VTask.comapDomain f hf (r • x) = r • VTask.comapDomain f hf x
